title: Global sections vanishing under comparison pullback
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, and let $A$ be a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category in the common site universe. Let $M$ be an etale $A$-valued sheaf and $q$ a nonnegative integer. If $R^q\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{et}},M)$ is zero, then $R^q\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\nu_X^*M)$ is zero. Both section functors are evaluation at the terminal identity object, and the comparison inverse image is that of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

proof.text: This is the existing source-library lemma. Its proof identifies global sections after comparison direct image with pro-etale global sections, derives that composition using preservation of injectives, and uses the invertible bounded-below comparison unit. Homology and the single-object derived comparison give an isomorphism with the original etale right-derived sections; transport the assumed zero object along it.
